review_role: Independent DSL audit by one reviewer; offline and read-only hardware scope
release_verdict: BLOCKED: native endpoint/control/bearer/automatic PPPoE runtime is absent and no real DSL line path has been verified

executive_summary.reason: Existing work is reverse-engineering evidence and offline contracts, not a running native DSL service. Final cold-power-on Telekom authentication and LAN Internet cannot currently be promised.

P0_release_blockers.required: Exclusive PON PCS/board ownership: resolve eth1/PHY14 2500base-x versus original DSL USXGMII before either can take over.
Native ordered endpoint reset/MDIO/DDR/iNIC/tclinux bootstrap with verified ready and recovery.
Native management/data path, fresh metadata/status provider, service packaging and netifd integration.
Program/read back the actual ADSL ATM or VDSL PTM service with verified VLAN/MTU boundary.
Automatic PPPoE line authentication, IPv4/IPv6/PD and real LAN client connectivity without manual credentials.

executive_summary.minimum_order: Freeze inputs/image -> exclusive PCS owner -> endpoint bootstrap -> current native control/status -> bearer/VLAN -> automatic PPPoE -> IPv4/IPv6/PD/LAN -> failure/retry -> repeated clean-image cold acceptance.
must_compare_with_complete_original_runt: Actual cold endpoint startup and DDR/iNIC/tclinux transfer/execute ACKs, lengths, addresses, CRC/endianness, timing and readiness publication.
Board mux/clock/reset/SerDes routing and actual relationship of DSL, eth1/PHY14 and both external2.5G ports.
Proprietary backend service commands/readbacks, line-status tokens and netifd control-device lifecycle.
Actual PPP discovery/authentication/provisioning sequence to distinguish static preset/line authentication from personal account or ACS/phone downloads.
must_use_real_owner_line: Actual synchronization/modulation/annex/bearer and valid current status.
Accepted fresh PPPoE authentication using the intended no-manual-credentials flow.
IPv4/IPv6, delegated LAN prefix/routes/DNS and verified client traffic.
Line unplug/replug, retraining, endpoint/helper death, reload and repeated full cold-power recovery.
executive_summary.no_test_promotion: 32 host tests,105 original-code vectors,3 allocation failures,5 UI replays and14 additional guest cases are offline evidence; they are not endpoint or line acceptance.
executive_summary.coverage_boundary: One independent reviewer inspected the complete known native DSL-related tool/bringup surface and selected exact OEM functions/sources. This is not a claim of complete proprietary firmware equivalence.

evidence_limits: Selected exact original ELF functions ran under ARM64 emulation; OS, endpoint, network, IPC and proc inputs were modeled.
The complete proprietary HSM/backend/endpoint firmware and every outer caller were not reconstructed.
Acceptance of a synthetic malformed packet by a helper is a native-port contract risk, not proof of an exploitable whole-appliance flaw.
Selected GPL/BSP sources do not automatically correspond exactly to the running original modules.
No native DSL initialization, line synchronization, PPP authentication, IPv6 PD or line recovery was tested.
Source citations identify the audited snapshot. Binary witnesses use offsets rather than invented source lines.

severity_definition.P0: Missing mandatory runtime or conflicting ownership; blocks cold-boot automatic DSL Internet.
severity_definition.P1: Contract, recovery or evidence gate to resolve before DSL release; not necessarily an observed native runtime defect.
severity_definition.P2: Bounded compatibility hazard requiring an explicit implementation constraint.

reviewed_domains: Exact live libpt/libblapi provenance versus legacy GPL/BSP xdsl interfaces and ae_wan hooks.
HSM, DDR calibration, iNIC and tclinux artifacts, startup order, image integrity/addressing and execute handshake.
GPIO21 reset, MDIO24, GPIO40 mux, clock/SerDes/PMA/PCS initialization and ownership.
M71/M72 PON PCS ownership by gdm2/eth1/PHY14 and M73/M75 inheritance.
Wire framing, length, endianness, operation fields, socket filtering and response correlation.
Shared-memory layout, readiness, ownership/generation, producer limits, errors and cleanup.
Current line showtime/modulation/annex/bearer, stale status and failure handling.
ADSL ATM VPI/VCI/LLC versus VDSL PTM and endpoint-to-host Ethernet boundaries.
VLAN7 placement, PCP, MTU/MRU and DMA/cache/checksum/offload boundaries.
PPPoE discovery/session/authentication, retry and stale-session handling.
Pinned Telekom provider database/UI replay and asynchronous partial failures.
EasyLogin/line authentication versus factory preset, account download, TR069/ACS and telephone provisioning.
IPv4 IPCP, IPv6CP, DHCPv6 PD, routes, DNS and LAN client service.
Cold/warm boot, line loss, helper/endpoint crash, partial failure, PCS restore and observability.
Native image integration, mock self-confirmation limits and actual end-to-end release gates.

current_build_read_only_scan.method: Read through WSL from current ponwrt-system-m55; regular text files <=2MiB, symlinks skipped
current_build_read_only_scan.limitation: Supporting evidence alongside implementation/image inspection; absence of strings alone cannot prove arbitrary binary behavior.

findings.title: Current persistent image has no native DSL-to-Internet implementation
findings.trigger: Clean installation or cold boot expecting automatic Telekom Internet.

evidence.note: No socket or device operations.
Does not configure modem or start PPPoE.
Removes wan and wan6; line11 selects isolated lan-test.

findings.impact: No native endpoint loader, live management/data path, status provider, bearer executor or automatic PPPoE supervisor consumes the offline contracts. Passing models cannot create Internet service.
findings.fix: Implement/package the dependency stages below and connect service startup to netifd. Expose truthful stage states; keep DSL release blocked until the complete path is accepted.
findings.offline_regression: Image inventory must require all executables, private firmware manifest, init services, native providers and network protocols; deliberately omitted components must reject readiness.
findings.real_acceptance: Final flashed image, clean overlay, full power-off/on and attached owner line must create fresh DSL and PPP sessions without shell setup or manual credentials.

findings.title: Native eth1 occupies the PON PCS selected by original DSL startup
findings.trigger: Enabling DSL/USXGMII while M71/M72/M73/M75 gdm2/eth1/PHY14 remains active.

evidence.note: pcs@1fa08000; shared SCU/reset/PMA windows; line13 resets48/0/15; line16 2500base-x; lines44-49 gdm2/PHY14 consumer.
Inherits the active multigig DTS.
Original sys serdes0/2/2/7 selects DSL/WAN/USXGMII.
Numeric selectors alone do not prove full programming/runtime equivalence.
Native PON Ethernet profile accepts usxgmii or2500base-x and records interface type at47-48;2500 profile changes optical-rate handling.
Electrical receiver programming includes non-optical PON Ethernet2500 case; no DSL ownership/recovery integration is supplied by this correction.

findings.impact: One hardware block has incompatible owners/modes: current Ethernet2500base-x versus original DSL USXGMII. Independently enabling both can disrupt Ethernet, endpoint DMA, IRQs or recovery. Physical routing/mux and possible simultaneous port availability are not fully established.
findings.fix: Use a single exclusive board-mode owner. Stop netdev queues/NAPI/DMA/IRQs and detach phylink/PCS before takeover; verify the complete DSL clocks/resets/SerDes sequence. Unwind partial failures and restore prior Ethernet mode. Measure routing/mux before deciding which external port is unavailable.
findings.offline_regression: Reject concurrent consumers; inject each takeover failure and prove quiescence, cleanup and restoration. Compare complete register ordering and delays, not only constants.
findings.real_acceptance: Capture OEM/native cold mode evidence and exercise Ethernet-to-DSL-to-Ethernet plus cold recovery without stale carrier, DMA or IRQ state. Do not claim two2.5G ports plus DSL without measured routing evidence.

findings.title: Ordered HSM/endpoint bootstrap has no native implementation
findings.trigger: Endpoint cold reset, power loss or previous interrupted download.

evidence.note: GPIO21 reset low at172-175, MDIO support177-184, GPIO40 mux187-191, chardevs200-201, SerDes205, ae_wan208, register write212, HSM213, client_info218, ae_wan up366.
Artifact identities and script arguments, not native boot validation.

findings.impact: Extracting HSM/ddr_cal/iNIC/tclinux does not initialize the endpoint on the native kernel. GPIO21 polarity/timing, MDIO24 reachability, mux and staged startup remain required implementation and measurement work.
findings.fix: Reconstruct stage preconditions, acknowledgements, deadlines and rollback. Preserve exact private inputs and validate each stage; copy no raw register write without ownership and compatibility checks.
findings.offline_regression: Missing/malformed input, absent MDIO, link timeout, interrupted stage and endpoint reset must prevent success and produce bounded stage-specific recovery.
findings.real_acceptance: Cold/warm/interrupted starts converge on verified endpoint readiness. Absent endpoint times out safely and management remains reachable.

findings.title: Input identity is known but full image-transfer/execute contract is not
findings.trigger: Writing a native downloader or reusing HSM on a different kernel.

evidence.note: Operation semantics/safety unresolved.
Real endpoint compatibility explicitly unproven.

findings.impact: Hashes/sizes do not prove load-address limits, container headers, segment/chunk lengths, CRC/endian handling, DDR calibration handoff, iNIC-to-tclinux transition or verified execute readiness.
findings.fix: Decode exact HSM transfer state transitions and specify address/length overflow rules, integrity, current-stage ACK, execute entry, retry limits and safe reset. Reject mismatched private inputs.
findings.offline_regression: Corrupt/truncated/oversized images, wrong CRC/endian/address, stale/wrong-stage ACK, reset and timeout must fail before execute/ready. Golden traces must be independent OEM evidence.
findings.real_acceptance: Compare native/OEM download/execute exchanges on the same endpoint and recover after every forced partial-stage failure.

findings.title: Original libpt helper accepts malformed modeled replies without payload identity validation
findings.trigger: Using SRC_blapi return0 as proof of a fresh valid response in a native port.

evidence.note: Nonpositive receive length rejects; <=218 bypasses the upper-size branch; first source is learned rather than strictly matched.
Selected comparison uses the original request word saved on stack, not received transaction identity.
Offline decoder checks exact payload length/magic/version, but no native receiver exists.

findings.impact: Actual pinned ARM64 code with synthetic replies returns0 and copies synthetic status0x11223344 for wrong magic/version/operation/suboperation/source and a32-byte frame. A13-byte frame returns0/status0 due fresh zeroed model memory; a real allocator could retain stale bytes. This does not establish a vulnerability in the complete OEM appliance.
findings.fix: Native receiver must validate framing/length, protocol/version, expected interface/source, response role, current operation/transaction/generation before output. Discard unmatched/stale packets within a bounded deadline. Document trusted-link preconditions instead of assuming them.
findings.offline_regression: Keep one valid control and seven mutations; add duplicate/reordered/old-generation replies, multiple sources, VLAN/padding and poisoned reuse buffers. Rejections cannot refresh status or produce success.
findings.real_acceptance: Prove real responses belong to the current request/endpoint generation; timeout/replay/reconnect cannot report stale synchronization or Internet.

findings.title: Metadata/socket setup has positive errors and fatal process paths
findings.trigger: Caller checks only ret<0, embeds old libpt into a long-lived controller or retries after IPC/socket failure.

evidence.note: Not-ready2, socket-failure1.
Guest exit(1) captured rather than killing host.

findings.impact: All four injected option failures and shmget failure request exit(1); shmat=-1 reaches an unmapped read. A negative-only check can treat failure as success; embedding fatal legacy errors can kill the controller.
findings.fix: Use a native explicit error contract with checked shmget/shmat and cleanup. If reusing legacy code, isolate/supervise it and map positive errors, exits and signals to bounded retries with readiness invalidation; never embed fatal behavior in netifd.
findings.offline_regression: Six new failures plus socket failure, permission loss, disappearing device and IPC removal must leave no FD/IPC leak or stale-ready survivor.
findings.real_acceptance: Helper/endpoint death during setup leaves management responsive and state unavailable; controlled retry recovers without power-cycle dependence.

findings.title: Metadata bit0 is transport readiness with unresolved ownership/freshness
findings.trigger: Producer/consumer startup races, HSM crash/restart, stale segment or endpoint reset.

evidence.note: Key0x1492,40bytes,IPC_CREAT|0666; selected consumer copies28bytes.
Only bit0 gates BEEA; other tested selectors bypass this gate.
Selected signal handler clears first28bytes; intermediate flag values5/2 observed, full producer semantics unresolved.

findings.impact: Complete atomic publication, remaining fields, generation, owner death and cleanup are unproven. Readiness is not showtime, valid bearer or a PPP session; stale data can cross a restart.
findings.fix: Single-owner metadata with endpoint/boot generation and atomic publish only after verified completion. Invalidate before reset/reload/shutdown; require current owner/freshness. Reconstruct compatibility fields before legacy interoperation.
findings.offline_regression: Torn publication, stale segment, wrong owner/permissions, clean signal versus SIGKILL and consumer racing reset must not preserve ready.
findings.real_acceptance: No old endpoint/line/session state survives process restart, endpoint reset or power cycle; timestamped transitions show current generation.

findings.title: HSM/libpt interface-name limits are shorter than Linux IFNAMSIZ
findings.trigger: Long native compatibility names or VLAN-style names on the legacy control path.

evidence.note: Producer clamps copied length to9bytes.
Consumer permits12bytes; declared13 triggers BRK#1000.

findings.impact: Linux-accepted names may truncate at the producer or trap in the consumer; original ae_wan fits.
findings.fix: Use a deliberately bounded compatibility name; reject overlong/malformed names before publication and require exact current name-to-ifindex match after recreation.
findings.offline_regression: Lengths8/9/10/12/13, missing/embedded NUL and declared-length mismatch must not silently truncate, bind another device or trap.
findings.real_acceptance: Real control socket binds only the intended current interface before and after recreation; rejected names give a clear error.

findings.title: Line status needs independent validity and freshness
findings.trigger: Read failure after previous up, unexpected token or endpoint generation change.

evidence.note: Failure=-1; caller state word untouched.
17 exact guest vectors with modeled proc strings; substring up/PTM behavior.

findings.impact: Using stale caller state can start PPP over a down/wrong bearer. Parser quirks with synthetic strings do not prove the OEM emits malformed status. Native live provider is absent.
findings.fix: Real bounded provider must return validity, generation/time, showtime/modulation/annex/bearer and explicit unknown/down. Invalidate on read/error/restart and map only verified endpoint tokens; do not infer up from fixtures or metadata.
findings.offline_regression: 17 guest vectors plus stale-up-after-failure, truncation, unknown mode, mixed tokens and generation change; invalid showtime stops a native session.
findings.real_acceptance: Compare actual status to OEM on the same line; unplug/replug and endpoint reset clear old up state.

findings.title: ADSL ATM and VDSL PTM service executor is absent
findings.trigger: Real synchronization completes and the correct Telekom service must be programmed.

evidence.note: Pinned ADSL ATM VPI1/VCI32 LLC VLAN7 PPPoE; VDSL PTM VLAN7 PPPoE.
Candidate selection returns a dict, not endpoint programming.
Selected ae_wan/control evidence does not implement a bearer.

findings.impact: No PVC/PTM setup, service readback or native data attachment exists. Host Ethernet to an endpoint does not prove ADSL ATM/PTM service creation.
findings.fix: Reverse the backend command/readback contract and implement idempotent service setup based on current showtime; reconcile/rollback partial services before PPP. Explicitly gate unsupported annex/modulation/multibearer/vectoring requirements.
findings.offline_regression: ADSL/ADSL2/ADSL2+/VDSL2, unknown/no-showtime, wrong PVC, endpoint rejection, readback mismatch, retrain and duplicate startup. Independent OEM evidence must validate expected results.
findings.real_acceptance: Read back actual bearer/PVC/encapsulation and show bidirectional PPPoE discovery on the owner line; retraining selects/rebuilds the correct service.

findings.title: VLAN7 placement, PCP and effective MTU lack end-to-end proof
findings.trigger: Joining native Ethernet, endpoint ATM/PTM and PPPoE, particularly with offload enabled.

evidence.note: VLAN placement explicitly requires endpoint/host validation.
Offline VLAN parsing is not a runtime placement policy.

findings.impact: Parsing one/two tags proves byte parsing only. Host-side versus endpoint-side tagging, management/data separation, PCP, padding, ATM/PTM overhead and PPP MTU/MRU are not verified. Double tagging or altered control frames can silently prevent service.
findings.fix: Trace independent OEM control/data boundaries and readbacks; choose one verified VLAN/PCP/MTU policy. Verify DMA metadata, checksum/GSO and PPPoE/VLAN fallback separately from basic service.
findings.offline_regression: Tagged/untagged management/data, duplicate tags, PCP/endian mutation, minimum frames, MTU boundaries and unsupported layouts; tolerant parsing cannot silently define production policy.
findings.real_acceptance: Observe PADI/PADO/PADR/PADS on intended service/interface; IPv4 DF and IPv6 PMTU/client traffic work at negotiated MTU. Qualify baseline without acceleration before separate offload validation.

findings.title: Factory profile replay is not a native automatic PPPoE service
findings.trigger: Expecting no manual account entry and automatic Telekom line login.

evidence.note: Automatic/no-manual is a profile declaration.
Static factory provider preset, not saved customer account.
Backend modeled; no real network; line124 DSL/PPPoE/ACS false.

findings.impact: UI/database equality proves static preset identity and Requested action only. No native PPPoE discovery/session/auth/IPCP controller consumes it. No real line test proves acceptance or personal account download; a preset/placeholder cannot be labeled a verified account.
findings.fix: Implement supervised automatic connection after real bearer readiness using the verified applicable factory/line-auth mechanism. Keep secrets private and out of logs; report auth rejection precisely. Manual credentials are not a substitute for the requested automatic behavior.
findings.offline_regression: Independent discovery/session/auth-reject/timeout/backoff/stale-session/process-restart tests, with modeled authentication labeled explicitly.
findings.real_acceptance: Actual owner Telekom line accepts a new cold-boot session with clean overlay, no preexisting session and no manual credentials. Record sanitized stages/network state only.

findings.title: OEM netifd exempts ae_wan from ordinary teardown
findings.trigger: ifdown/reload, PPP reconnect, endpoint restart or PCS mode switch.

evidence.note: Original source line966 skips flag handling for ae_wan.
Original source line1156 skips device-state clearing for ae_wan.

findings.impact: Exact live netifd correspondence is not proved. Generic teardown may destroy endpoint control needed for recovery; blindly copying exemptions may leave active DMA/queues across a mode change.
findings.fix: Define separate control-device, bearer and PPP ownership/lifetimes. Trace exact OEM callers; explicitly retain the required control plane during reconnect and fully quiesce resources for endpoint reset/PCS takeover.
findings.offline_regression: Concurrent reload, ifdown/up, PPP/endpoint crash and mode transitions: neither accidental control loss nor leaked active resources.
findings.real_acceptance: Repeated live reload/reconnect works without power-cycle dependency; teardown/restore stays bounded and management reachable.

findings.title: OEM UI requests autodetect even after a profile-add callback fails
findings.trigger: One candidate add fails or callbacks finish in reverse order.

evidence.note: Modeled callback invokes fail/success.
Recorded original partial-failure behavior; five cases at116-117.

findings.impact: Exact pinned UI reaches Requested after both callbacks, including rejected adds. This confirms UI flow with modeled backend callbacks; it does not prove proprietary backend accepts invalid service or claims a connected session.
findings.fix: Native executor must distinguish completed callbacks from success, verify readback and reconcile/rollback partial profiles before starting the selected valid candidate.
findings.offline_regression: Each delete/add/set/readback failure and callback reorder/duplicate produces deterministic reconciliation, never connected/ready merely from callback completion.
findings.real_acceptance: A forced recoverable native profile rejection reports its stage, clears stale state and recovers without duplicate services after correction.

findings.title: IPv4, IPv6 and delegated LAN service remain unverified declarations
findings.trigger: PPP appears up but LAN clients require Internet service.

evidence.note: IPv4/IPv6 intent, not negotiated runtime.
Explicit OEM enable flags only.
wan6 removed; isolated LAN omits router/DNS DHCP advertisements at21-22.

findings.impact: No IPCP/routes/DNS, IPv6CP, DHCPv6-PD, LAN RA/prefix or renewal/reconnect behavior exists on the native DSL path. A process PID, metadata-ready or Requested cannot prove usable Internet.
findings.fix: Implement full netifd IPv4/IPv6 lifecycle with routes, DNS, firewall/NAT as applicable, LAN RA/prefix and invalidation/renewal. Keep address-family outcomes separate from optional phone/ACS/offload.
findings.offline_regression: IPCP/IPv6CP rejection, absent/expired/changed PD, DNS/route replacement, WAN reconnect and stale-state removal.
findings.real_acceptance: LAN client resolves names and verifies IPv4/IPv6 traffic; delegated prefix/routes/DNS handle renewal and reconnect without stale data.

findings.title: EasyLogin, account download and phone/ACS provisioning are separate claims
findings.trigger: Explaining original plug-and-play behavior or implementing provisioning.

evidence.note: Personal-account download, phone and hardware verification are false.

findings.impact: Owner observation and static presets support the automatic-service requirement, but do not prove personal PPP credentials are downloaded, exact backend protocol, or native phone/TR069 compatibility. General Telekom pages are context, not this device's implementation evidence.
findings.fix: Trace original autodetect/backend and actual PPP authentication separately from TR069/ACS/telephone. Implement only verified authorized mechanisms; keep private data private and do not invent ACS endpoints or assume ACS is required before basic line login.
findings.offline_regression: Reports must distinguish static-preset identity, accepted line authentication, actual account download and phone provisioning; unknowns stay unknown/false.
findings.real_acceptance: Prove basic automatic Internet first on the owner line. Qualify account download/ACS/phone only with separate observed evidence.

findings.title: Legacy GPL/BSP interfaces are not proof of the exact live runtime ABI
findings.trigger: Porting old xdsl ioctl headers, kernel modules or proprietary hooks.

evidence.note: Offline source-derived296-byte ioctl, no active handler validation.
Exact live libpt/libblapi and absent legacy device nodes; mappings do not prove calls.
ELF64 little-endian AArch64; PT_INTERP=/lib/ld-musl-aarch64.so.1. No glibc-interpreter mismatch is claimed.

findings.impact: Proprietary ae_wan/hooks matching the live module are not fully reconstructed. Legacy node/ioctl descriptions and source call inventories do not prove the live path. Kernel ABI, DMA address/cache/alignment/endianness and ownership are unresolved gates.
findings.fix: Record exact artifact hashes, source lineage, symbols and live-use witnesses for each interface. Do not transplant5.4.55 modules or invoke diagnostics based only on an old header. Verify AArch64 musl dependencies and implement native bounded kernel interfaces.
findings.offline_regression: Reject unpinned artifacts/unsupported layouts; verify ioctl sizes, DMA width/alignment/ownership, kernel APIs and module/helper dependencies.
findings.real_acceptance: Identify actual running native modules/helpers/netdev/control/data path and compare with measured exact OEM behavior, not just similar source.

findings.title: Offline agreement cannot establish endpoint, line or cold-boot equivalence
findings.trigger: Promoting modeled callbacks or selector comparisons to a hardware-ready claim.

evidence.note: Real endpoint compatibility false.
No network and modeled backend.
Not complete programming/runtime equivalence.

findings.impact: Current tests honestly label scope but fixtures can self-confirm selected contracts while missing timing, DMA/cache, source correlation, real endpoint/line and recovery. DSL is disconnected; full equivalence and immediate auto-login are not established.
findings.fix: Separate source review, exact guest execution, native runtime, endpoint hardware, real line and LAN service evidence. Require independent OEM traces and stage-specific failure/retry observability before every release gate.
findings.offline_regression: Keep current contracts and new negatives, add independent golden inputs, and prevent fixture-generated ready/success from entering production state.
findings.real_acceptance: Pass the final-image owner-line checklist below. Any unresolved mandatory gate blocks DSL release even when all offline tests pass.

minimum_dependency_order.dependency: Freeze image and exact private OEM input manifest; preserve factory/rescue.
minimum_dependency_order.exit_evidence: Inventory proves native components and input availability; changed/missing inputs rejected.

minimum_dependency_order.dependency: Exclusive board/PCS owner before endpoint access.
minimum_dependency_order.exit_evidence: Measured mux/reset/clock/SerDes sequence, quiesced DMA/IRQs and restoration after failed takeover.

minimum_dependency_order.dependency: DDR/iNIC/tclinux loading and verified execute stages.
minimum_dependency_order.exit_evidence: Current-stage ACK/integrity/deadline and recovery from interrupted download.

minimum_dependency_order.dependency: Native ae_wan-equivalent management/data path and metadata lifecycle.
minimum_dependency_order.exit_evidence: Current interface/owner/generation, bounded receiver and no stale-ready/fatal host error.
Agrees with independent OEM/line evidence and invalidates on loss/error.

minimum_dependency_order.dependency: ATM/PTM service executor and verified VLAN/MTU policy.
minimum_dependency_order.exit_evidence: Actual readback and bidirectional discovery on intended service.

minimum_dependency_order.dependency: Automatic PPPoE discovery/session/auth and IPv4 configuration.
minimum_dependency_order.exit_evidence: Fresh accepted session, IPCP/routes/DNS and LAN IPv4 without manual credentials.

minimum_dependency_order.dependency: IPv6CP, DHCPv6-PD, LAN RA/addressing and renewal.
minimum_dependency_order.exit_evidence: Real LAN IPv6 with prefix/route/DNS lifecycle.
Measured bounded recovery from line loss, endpoint reset, helper death and partial initialization.
Repeated full power-off/on reaches automatic dual-stack LAN service; optional phone/ACS/offload qualified separately.

minimum_end_to_end_acceptance: Remind owner to attach the disconnected DSL line before testing. Record a sanitized factory baseline on this same line. Clarify actual ADSL/VDSL service; one line cannot be assumed to test both.
Final flashed image with clean overlay and no old PPP session. No manual credentials, hidden CLI setup, host-assisted firmware load or preserved factory runtime. Preserve factory/rescue.

From full power-off, timestamp the boot generation, input hashes and verified ownership/load/ready/showtime stages. Choose deadlines from measured OEM and supported line behavior rather than an invented fixed timeout.
Read back actual bearer/PVC/encapsulation/VLAN. Observe new PADI/PADO/PADR/PADS, authentication and negotiated configuration for this boot. A ready bit, Requested or PPP PID is insufficient.
LAN client obtains configuration, resolves DNS and exchanges verified IPv4/IPv6 traffic. Check MTU/PMTU, delegated prefix/routes and renewal. Report family-specific failure explicitly.

Repeat cold/warm/service starts, line unplug/replug, endpoint/helper death and controlled partial-stage failure. Prove state invalidation, bounded recovery, responsive management and no resource leak.
Recheck intended Ethernet availability and restoration in the measured board mode. True2.5G throughput, PPPoE/VLAN offload, phone and ACS require separate evidence.

external_primary_sources.paraphrase: Telekom describes automatic line-based recognition/storage of Internet access and fixed-line number information; this is context, not proof of this native implementation.
EasySupport describes remote configuration for supported enabled devices on Telekom service; native VB235v ACS compatibility is not established.

mutations.different_source_mac: Use a different synthetic Ethernet source.
mutations.short_payload: Truncate Ethernet frame to32bytes, retaining status at frame offset26.
mutations.short_header: Truncate frame to13bytes; model memory beyond copied data is fresh/zero.

new_reply_observations.reproduction: Use pinned emulate_dsl_libpt.Transaction with a synthetic host record. Wrap modeled sendto to mutate its generated reply, then execute unchanged guest pt_pkt_recv/SRC_blapi. All OS/socket replies remain synthetic.

outer_filter_review.observed_preconditions: Linux EtherType and interface socket selection provide implicit filtering in a real OS. No additional BPF/source/transaction filter was observed in the reviewed helper functions.
outer_filter_review.not_exhausted: Every proprietary outer caller, trust relationship and whole-appliance exposure remains outside the complete evidence.
outer_filter_review.classification: Direct-reuse/native-port contract risk, not a complete OEM vulnerability claim.

new_error_observations.reproduction: Run pinned Metadata pt_fd_open with modeled option_fails; separately override shmget=-1 and shmat=pointer-width-1. Guest instructions are unchanged; no real IPC exists.
